modules.title: Points and the finance ledger
source: CONTRACT.md §7 Endpoints M3 Points and M3 Ledger
CONTRACT.md §2.4 DDL (ledger_accounts, ledger_transactions, ledger_entries, point_lots, lot_consumptions, suite_counters)

fields.name: balance
fields.notes: written only by trigger ledger_entries_apply (L3); CHECK balance >= 0 for member accounts (L2)

fields.name: lifetime_earned
fields.notes: CHECK >= 0; moved by postings with lifetime deltas; floor 0 on reversal

fields.name: tier
fields.notes: member accounts only; recomputed on every posting that changes lifetime_earned (L9)

entities.retention: Account row kept; personal link to principal cleared by erasure (Strata ret-ledger-account analogue).

strata.how: A member account maps to a Strata ledger account of one unit (for example unit points) whose owner is the principal (ledger-owner principal). Balance is derived from entries (ldg-020, verify-ledger-balance CT-287) and cannot be written (ldg-021). The five system accounts map to pools (ledger-pool-decl, ledger-owner pool). Lifetime_earned and tier have no Strata counterpart: the ledger account header holds balance and last-sequence only.
strata.note: Plinth has one account per member plus five system accounts with negative issuance allowed; Strata pools have no floor so the same shape is expressible. Tier is a Plinth-only field and is not in ledger-account.

entities.retention: Append-only (triggers ledger_transactions_append_only); no erasure of amounts.

strata.how: Strata has no transaction header. Each posting is one journal entry on one account (ledger-entry: account, sequence, amount, idempotency-key, reason, caused-by, at, corrects). Grouping several entries into one transaction, with a transaction number, memo, actor, surface and references, is not a Strata type.
evidence: specifications/requirements.jsonc ldg-010 (one ledger-entry-posted event per entry)
strata.note: Idempotency per entry exists (ldg-006/007). The Plinth transaction header is the grouping that double-entry needs.

strata.how: ledger-entry (account, sequence, amount, idempotency-key, reason, caused-by, at, corrects) is the Strata journal row and is append-only (ldg-022) with gapless numbering (ldg-019). Missing here: tier_after, the transaction grouping (see ledger_transactions) and the balance_after column (Strata returns it in ledger-posting-result).
strata.note: Strata entries carry caused-by only; Plinth also records on_behalf_of through the transaction.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.notes: occurred_at + Program.expiry.months for awards; carried unchanged by transfers, refunds and restores

entities.retention: Rows kept; remaining goes to 0 on expiry.

strata.how: Strata expiry is per unit and per calendar period: ledger-unit-decl carries ledger-expiry {period, periods} and buckets hold credit per period-start (ledger-bucket). Lots with their own exact expires_at, carried through transfer and refund restores, have no Strata type.
evidence: specifications/requirements.jsonc ldg-1545 (debit consumes oldest bucket first), ldg-1546 (expiry entry), ldg-2883 (36 buckets)
strata.note: Plinth grants 1 to 36 month life per award (Program.expiry.months); Strata's period is fixed per unit.

fields.name: amount
fields.notes: positive consumed, negative restored; PRIMARY KEY (txn_id, lot_id)

strata.how: No Strata equivalent: a debit consumes buckets (ldg-1545) but the consumption is not recorded as rows that a read can list per transaction.
Gapless human-readable numbers (txn_no, order_no R-000123) have no Strata declaration.
evidence: specifications/boundary.jsonc record-id and ledger-account-id (derived ids, no sequence type)
strata.note: Strata ledger entries are numbered per account, not per workspace.

strata.how: A singleton object (Program) with the numeric limits as product settings (setting-def type i64, levels tenant, allowed) and the tier ladder as rows of an object Tier with min_points and rank. Expiry months cannot vary per award because ledger-unit-decl's expiry is static per unit (see F-ledger-lot-expiry).

authz.approval: Agent calls are held (registry agent: approval, CONTRACT §3.7); no approval for humans.

effects: Lock sender account, consume sender lots FIFO (FOR UPDATE)
Insert ledger_transactions txn_type transfer, key transfer:<from>:<idempotency_key>
One point_lots row per consumed lot for recipient, same expires_at
operations.idempotency: Action record (action_idempotency) plus ledger key transfer:<from>:<idempotency_key> with request hash (L7). CONTRACT §7.2 says the key is the action key; the code uses transfer:<from>:<key>.
operations.audit: ledger_transactions row with actor, on_behalf_of, surface; points.posted domain events.

strata.how: Two post-ledger steps in one operation: a post with owner Invoker (unit points, amount -n) and a post with owner principal = recipient (+n), in one tenant operation (opr-1541 atomicity). Self-transfer and disabled-recipient refusals as operation conditions (principal != recipient). Daily send limit as a second unit 'points_sent' with a period-cap per day and additions-only (ledger-period-cap, ldg-2902). FIFO lot carry-over needs the lot-expiry fundamental. Agent hold needs the approval fundamental.
strata.note: Strata limits count credits per account, not debits, so the send limit needs the parallel unit. Two legs in one operation are not checked to net to zero.

authz.approval: Above Program.awards.manager_max_per_award the whole award is filed in action_approvals; approver needs points:adjust and is not the requester.

effects: Promotion multipliers / bonus evaluated (earn context, channel recognition)
Per recipient: issuance -base, promotions -bonus (if any), member +(base+bonus)
New point_lots row expiring occurred_at + expiry.months
lifetime_earned increased, tier recomputed; tier.changed and tier_changed notification on move
Held case: action_approvals row, status pending_approval, approval.requested
operations.idempotency: Action idempotency plus ledger key award:<action key>:<handle> per recipient.
operations.audit: ledger_transactions per recipient; approval record for held awards; domain events.

strata.how: Post-ledger steps per recipient from the issuance pool (owner pool 'issuance', amount -n) and to the recipient (owner principal, +n). Recipient list: an operation input of type list, but the operation has no per-item loop (fan-out fundamental). Self-award as a condition. Manager limit as a branch that routes to request-approval-like hold. Multipliers need rule evaluation.
strata.note: Strata's fan-out exists for segment members in automations, not for a list input of an operation.

authz.separationOfDuties: None enforced: the handler does not refuse an adjustment on the operator's own account, and the registry reasons list only INSUFFICIENT_POINTS.

operations.idempotency: Action idempotency plus ledger key adjust:<idempotency_key>.
operations.audit: ledger_transactions with memo = reason; domain events. No approval step.

strata.how: post-ledger against the adjustments pool (owner pool) and the member (owner principal), in one operation. The debit refusal is the floor 0 of the member unit (ldg-013). The operator's own-account refusal is an operation condition (principal != member), expressible but not uniform. Holding a finance-only operation for a second approver is not in Strata.
strata.note: Plinth does not enforce self-adjustment refusal. Recorded as a separation-of-duties gap in invariant points.sod-adjust.

preconditions: not already reversed and not a reversal (ALREADY_EXISTS)
award, adjustment or bonus only (purchases reversed by order cancel/refund)
effects: Reversal txn with reverses_txn_id set, entries negated
Credit reversal consumes that txn's own lots first (INSUFFICIENT_POINTS if short)
operations.idempotency: Ledger key reverse:<txn_id>; UNIQUE (reverses_txn_id) makes it once.

strata.how: reverse-ledger step (posting id, reference, reason) negates the posting and is keyed by the reference (ldg-2900); reversing twice is refused (ldg-2901). Restoring consumed lots with their original expiry needs the lot-expiry fundamental. Reversal of a credit that leaves the balance below floor is refused by the floor.

effects: For each due lot: postExpiry, member -remaining, system:expiry +remaining, lot remaining 0 and expired_txn_id set
Key expiry:<lot_id>, so reruns post nothing new
operations.idempotency: Ledger key expiry:<lot_id>.

strata.how: expire-ledger-credits (CT-812, automation-worker, batches of 100 accounts per ldg-1547) with a schedule-due trigger (schedule-due). Strata expires whole periods per account, not single lots with exact timestamps.

preconditions: lots expiring exactly warn_days after the virtual day
no points.expiring already for member, date and window (dedupe)
effects: points.expiring domain event per member and date (audience member)
operations.idempotency: Dedupe by domain_events lookup, not by a unique key (race possible).

strata.how: Needs the members whose credit expires within N days: a query over ledger buckets, which the query-def cannot read (object-type only). Notice and schedule parts are expressible.

queries.description: Balance, tier progress, 30-day earned and redeemed, expiring soon, recent lines, transfer remaining today. Another member needs points:view-all.
queries.visibility: points:use own; points:view-all row predicate on member facts

strata.how: read-my-ledger-balance and list-my-ledger-entries (CT-807, CT-808) give balance and entries. Tier, 30-day sums by type and expiring buckets need derived facts and ledger queries.

queries.description: Statement lines with opening and closing balances, filtered by date and transaction types, with credits and debits totals.

strata.how: list-my-ledger-entries pages entries of one account by sequence (CT-808), with balance_after per entry. Date and transaction-type filters and totals are not in the list verb.

queries.description: One transaction with entries (every account leg), lot movements, references, reversal links.

strata.how: No transaction read: entries are read per account, and there are no lot movements to show.

queries.description: Expiry schedule by date from remaining lots, with next warning.
aggregates: sum remaining and lot count per expiry day

strata.how: Buckets per period are readable only through the ledger account header and entries; a schedule of exact expiry dates is not a Strata read.

queries.description: Tier definitions with member counts and viewer position.

strata.how: Tier rows as an object and a group-by count over member accounts if the tier is a stored field. Stored tier needs derived facts.

queries.description: All accounts with balances, filtered by kind and code search, paged.

strata.how: list-ledger-accounts ranks accounts of a unit by balance (ledger-order, ldg-1543 100 per page, ldg-2890 scan bound 10,000). No text search over codes and no kind filter across units; pools are a separate list.

queries.description: Recompute ledger invariants L1, L3, L4, L5, L9 over the whole ledger and list drift and unbalanced transactions (see note).
source: CONTRACT.md §7.3 (trial balance recomputes L1, L3, L4, L5, L9)

strata.how: verify-ledger-balance (CT-287) compares one account's balance with its replayed entries. No whole-ledger sum, no per-unit conservation, no lot reconciliation, no report.
strata.note: The registry summary says the trial balance checks L1-L8. The code checks L1, L3, L4, L5 and L9 only. L2, L6, L7 and L8 are enforced at write time and are not rechecked. This is a discrepancy to resolve in the spec.

events.payload: { txn_id, txn_no, txn_type, account, member, delta, balance, lifetime, memo }
events.trigger: every ledger transaction, one per account touched

strata.how: Strata emits ledger-entry-posted per entry (ldg-010) and ledger-posted triggers (trigger-event ledger-posted). Payloads name only account, unit, scope and entry number (ldg-2895), so balance and member are not in the event; notices reach a subscriber only if the read decision allows (ldg-2887).

events.trigger: a posting that crosses a tier floor

strata.how: Tier is not a Strata fact. A trigger on ledger-posted cannot read the lifetime total or compare tiers.
schedule-due triggers fire on recurrence, but the set of members with expiring credit needs the ledger query.

events.payload: { title: Your tier moved from X to Y, body }

strata.how: Depends on tier.changed, which Strata cannot derive.

widgets.purpose: Balance with tier, progress and expiring soon (large number, live).
widgets.a11y: Balance region has aria-busy while loading and aria-label; tier and expiring subsections carry aria-label (Recent activity, Points expiring soon); decorative icons aria-hidden.

strata.how: Object view with ledger balance as a read (read-my-ledger-balance) and a live binding on ledger events. Tier and expiring need derived facts.

widgets.purpose: Transfer form: recipient, amount with quick amounts, memo, review, done.
widgets.a11y: Steps list aria-label Transfer steps with aria-current on the active step; quick-amount group aria-label; status role for result messages; Enter confirms.

strata.how: Form on the transfer operation with prefill and validation; wizard steps are not a Strata screen kind (ui-screen-kind list/detail/editor/settings).

widgets.purpose: Statement with filters, opening and closing balances, totals and transaction detail.
widgets.a11y: Filter group aria-label Statement filters; type filter aria-label; busy state while loading; live region aria-live off for list refresh.

strata.how: Statement needs ledger queries with totals and transaction detail.

widgets.purpose: Expiry schedule by date with progress bars and next expiry.
widgets.a11y: Groups labelled Expiry dates and Next expiry; progress shown as text percent.

strata.how: Expiry dates per lot.

widgets.purpose: Tier ladder with perks, member counts and the viewer's position.
widgets.a11y: Ladder labelled Tier ladder, lowest first; polite live region for position change; decorative marks aria-hidden; disclosure with aria-expanded and aria-controls.

strata.how: Tier object rows as a list view; viewer position needs the derived tier.

widgets.purpose: Manager award to one or many members with category, reason, promotion multipliers shown and approval hold notice.
widgets.a11y: Steps list aria-label Award steps with aria-current; quick amounts group; status role for held and committed messages; Enter confirms.

strata.how: Form on points.award with list input; the per-recipient result needs fan-out; approval hold shown from the held state.

widgets.purpose: Ledger invariants and system account balances.
widgets.a11y: Invariants list labelled Ledger invariants; status role for overall result.

strata.how: Whole-ledger reconciliation report.

widgets.purpose: All accounts with balances, statement and transaction detail inside the widget, reverse a transaction.
widgets.a11y: Account filters group labelled Account filters; reverse is a dialog action (aria-label per tool).

strata.how: Ranked account list is a Strata list view (list-ledger-accounts); statement and reverse action are a record action and a reverse-ledger operation.

invariants.statement: Every ledger transaction's entries sum to 0 and number at least 2.

strata.how: Strata checks each posting independently; no transaction groups entries to sum.

invariants.statement: A member balance is never negative; the check refuses the debit before any write.

strata.how: ledger-limit on the member unit with floor 0 (ldg-013 refuses and changes nothing); pools have no floor, matching system accounts that go negative.

invariants.statement: ledger_accounts.balance equals the sum of its entries; only the entry trigger writes it.

strata.how: Balance is derived from the journal; no operation can set it (ldg-021); verify-ledger-balance replays the journal (ldg-2886).

invariants.statement: The sum of all balances is 0.

strata.how: No whole-ledger conservation check; a pool-to-account transfer is not required to net to zero across units.

invariants.statement: A member balance equals the sum of the remaining amounts of its lots.

strata.how: Strata has buckets per period, not lots with remaining amounts.

invariants.statement: Entries and transactions are immutable; a transaction is reversed at most once.

strata.how: No operation may change or remove an entry (ldg-022); a correction is a new entry naming the original (ldg-023); reversal once (ldg-2901).

invariants.statement: The same idempotency key and request return the same transaction; the same key with a different request is refused.

strata.how: Per-account idempotency: same key, amount, reason and correction replays the first entry with replayed true; differing one refused (ldg-006, ldg-007). Key is per account, Plinth's is per workspace; the difference is in scope only.

invariants.statement: Each transaction emits one points.posted per account touched, and event_seq is the first of them.

strata.how: One ledger-entry-posted event per entry (ldg-010), committed with the entry (ldg-009).

invariants.statement: A member tier equals the tier function of lifetime_earned.

strata.how: No lifetime total or tier function in Strata.

invariants.statement: Debits consume lots in (expires_at, earned_at, lot_id) order under row locks; an expired lot never funds a debit.

strata.how: Oldest-bucket-first debit (ldg-1545) and expiry job (ldg-1546) cover periods; exact lot order and per-lot expiry are not.

invariants.statement: A transfer needs transfer.enabled, min <= n <= max_per_transfer, sender's transfers today plus n <= max_per_day, and a recipient who is active and not the sender.

strata.how: Conditions on the operation for min, max and self; daily cap via a parallel unit with period-cap per day and additions-only (ldg-014, ldg-2902). Enabled flag as a setting condition.

invariants.statement: An award names at most awards.max_recipients recipients, the awarder is not a recipient, and an award above manager_max_per_award is held for points:adjust approval.

strata.how: Recipient count and self conditions expressible; hold above a threshold needs approval hold; per-item loop needs fan-out.

invariants.statement: The approver of a held award or adjustment is not its requester or the person an agent acted for.

strata.how: No operation hold with approver rules; automation request-approval has starter exclusion (WFL-2681) only for automation runs.
evidence: specifications/requirements.jsonc wfl-2681 (starter may not approve; cited in boundary.jsonc automation-approval)

invariants.statement: A principal may not adjust or reverse points on its own member account (no operator correcting its own balance).
source: Gap found in packages/engine/src/suite/handlers/points.ts:795-815 (no self check); CONTRACT.md §3.6 finance holds points:adjust and points:ledger

strata.how: Expressible per operation as a condition principal != member, but not enforced as a platform rule and not checked across roles that one principal may hold.
strata.note: Plinth gap: the requirement is not in CONTRACT.md; recorded for the spec to decide.

invariants.statement: Every ledger transaction records actor, on_behalf_of, surface, memo, idempotency key and request hash, and is kept append-only.

strata.how: Entries are append-only (ldg-022) and carry idempotency key, reason and caused-by (ldg-005); on_behalf_of, surface and approval link are not recorded.

invariants.statement: Every posting emits domain events in one chain (gapless seq, hash-linked), and the chain can be verified.

strata.how: Journal (journal-entry, replay-journal) and ledger-entry-posted events exist; the hash chain over domain events is not a documented Strata property in the boundary types.
strata.note: Unsure whether Strata's journal hashes entries; not checked further.

invariants.statement: The trial balance reports every drift between balances, entries, lots and tiers over the whole ledger, and the result is a stored report.

strata.how: Whole-ledger reconciliation report missing (see ledger.trial_balance).

modules.title: Store: catalogue, cart, wishlist, atomic checkout, order lifecycle, inventory
source: CONTRACT.md §7.4 Store catalogue, cart and wishlist
CONTRACT.md §2.4 DDL (product_inventory, inventory_movements, carts, cart_items, store_orders, store_order_items, store_order_events, wishlist_items, product_reviews)
packages/spec/src/suite/actions.ts (store.*, cart.*, checkout.*, wishlist.*, orders.*, inventory.*)

strata.how: Object type Product with these fields (str, int, bool, ref to Category, list for tags, Strata presentation for artwork). Status as a choice field. Config edits go through policies on the Product object (store:inventory and admin roles).
evidence: specifications/boundary.jsonc field-type (str, int, bool, ref, list, file)
strata.note: Artwork as a structured object becomes several fields or a file rendition.

strata.how: Object type Category with ordering field and status; products reference it by ref field.
An on_hand int field on Product (or a child Stock object), changed only by operations with a guard condition record.on_hand - delta >= 0; the operation is atomic (opr-1541).

entities.retention: Append-only (per CONTRACT §2.4 DDL; no trigger is listed for this table).

strata.how: Child records created by the same operation; immutability needs a policy that grants no update or delete, which is convention rather than an invariant.
Object Cart with a ref to the member's principal, unique per member; policy restricts to the owner.

fields.name: cart_id
fields.type: uuid ref -> carts ON DELETE CASCADE

strata.how: Child object CartLine referring to Cart and Product, qty int with validation 1..10 in the operation condition; the line limit (max_cart_lines) read from the Program setting.

fields.name: total_points
fields.notes: CHECK total = subtotal - discount; CHECK (total = 0) = (ledger_txn_id is null)

entities.retention: Kept; personal link to member cleared by erasure per retention rules.

strata.how: Object StoreOrder with status choice field; transitions as operations whose conditions check the current status and the policy. Total arithmetic as a condition. The ledger links need ledger transaction references, which Strata does not expose as records (ledger transactions are not objects). Approval hold for high-value orders needs the approval fundamental; quote hash needs the priced-quote fundamental.
strata.note: Strata has no bytes field type in field-type; quote_hash would be text.

strata.how: Child object OrderLine created in the checkout operation with snapshot fields; line arithmetic as a condition.
Child records per transition; append-only only by policy. Actor and on_behalf_of come from the operation subject.
Object WishlistItem with member and product refs; uniqueness on the pair via a composite key or find-then-create branch.
Object Review with rating int validation, length conditions, status choice, unique composite; eligibility by find-record of a delivered order for the member and product.

effects: Create or update cart_items row, or delete it at qty 0
operations.idempotency: Naturally idempotent (sets qty).

strata.how: Find-record of the member's cart line, Branch for create, update or delete, and conditions for qty, stock, tier and limit against Product and Program settings.
evidence: specifications/boundary.jsonc tenant-operation-step (find-record, branch, create-record, update-record, delete-record)

effects: Delete all cart_items of the member's cart
operations.idempotency: Naturally idempotent.

strata.how: Deleting an unknown number of lines needs a per-item loop; the step list is fixed.

operations.idempotency: Idempotent (no key; repeat returns in_wishlist true).

strata.how: Find-record then Branch to create-record when not found.

operations.idempotency: Idempotent.

strata.how: Find-record then Branch to delete-record when found.

preconditions: a delivered order of the member contains the product (NOT_ELIGIBLE)
no review by this member for this product (ALREADY_EXISTS)
effects: Insert product_reviews row, status published (or hidden by rule)
review.created with new average and count
operations.idempotency: Action idempotency plus UNIQUE (product_id, member_id).

strata.how: Find-record of a delivered order line for member and product, Branch on found, create-record, unique composite.

operations.idempotency: State set (repeat is harmless).
operations.audit: moderated_by and moderated_at on the review row; domain event.

strata.how: Update-record on status with a capability-gated policy and reason field.

authz.approval: Agent calls are held (registry agent: approval); a high-value order (total >= high_value_threshold_points) is filed for store:approve by a person who is not the member.

preconditions: lines, quantities, status, min_tier, limit_per_member valid
recomputed quote hash equals quote_hash (PRICE_CHANGED with fresh quote)
stock per line including free items (OUT_OF_STOCK)
effects: Lock cart row; lock member account, system:redemption, system:promotions (ascending); lock product_inventory rows; lock promotion_usage rows
Allocate order_no R-nnnnnn; insert store_orders (status placed, requires_approval per threshold) and store_order_items
Post purchase: member -total, system:redemption +total (skipped when total is 0)
Decrement product_inventory and insert inventory_movements reason order
Insert promotion_redemptions; increment promotion_usage; promotion.budget_alert on 50/80/100 % first crossing
If not requires_approval: transition to approved as service:store (second store_order_events row)
Events: order.placed, order.status_changed, points.posted, stock.changed, promotion.redeemed, cart.updated, approval.requested, notification.created
operations.idempotency: Action idempotency record per (workspace, principal, key); ledger key order:<order_id>.
operations.audit: store_order_events rows; ledger transaction; domain events; approval record when held.

strata.how: One tenant operation (opr-1541): member post-ledger (owner invoker, -total) and redemption post-ledger (owner pool redemption, +total); stock decrements as guarded update-record steps; order and lines as create-record; cart clear as fan-out; redemption records as create-record; promotion budget as a pool with a cap. Quote recomputation and hash equality need the priced-quote fundamental. The threshold hold needs the approval fundamental. Two legs are not checked to net to zero (journal fundamental).
evidence: specifications/requirements.jsonc opr-1541 (atomic), opr-1545 (posting key per step)
strata.note: Plinth takes locks in a fixed order (CONTRACT §7.5 step 2); Strata locks are the kernel's revision guard (cms-1552), not the same ordering.

effects: order.status_changed to member and store staff
operations.idempotency: Action idempotency record.
operations.audit: store_order_events row with actor and on_behalf_of.

strata.how: Update-record of status with a condition status == placed and principal != member; region row filter needs scoped roles.

operations.idempotency: Action idempotency record.

effects: Purchase bonus credited: promotion_bonus, member +bonus, key order-bonus:<order_id>, bonus_txn_id set
operations.idempotency: Action idempotency record; ledger key order-bonus:<order_id>.

strata.how: Update-record status guard plus a post-ledger step conditional on bonus > 0 (Branch step); bonus pool owner pool promotions, owner principal member.

authz.permission: store:shop (member within window) or store:orders (before fulfilled) or store:approve (reject from approvals inbox)

preconditions: member: now within cancel_window_minutes of placed_at (NOT_ELIGIBLE after)
effects: Refund posting of total_points (system:redemption -total, member +total; key refund:<order_id>)
Restock (default on): inventory_movements reason cancel, on_hand up
operations.idempotency: Action idempotency record; ledger key refund:<order_id>.

strata.how: reverse-ledger of the purchase posting keyed by the order reference; guarded update-record for status; restock as an inventory update; the promotion usage reversal as a fan-out over redemptions; window test with ms-between and now.
strata.note: The purchase used FIFO lots; the refund must restore the same expires_at, which needs the lot-expiry fundamental.

effects: Bonus clawback: min(bonus, balance) reversed when bonus credited
operations.idempotency: Action idempotency record; ledger key refund:<order_id>.

strata.how: The bonus clawback min(bonus, balance) reads a member balance, which no expression can read (showcase gap 3). Refund posting and restock are expressible; agent hold needs the approval fundamental.

operations.idempotency: Action idempotency record.

strata.how: Update-record with guard on_hand + delta >= 0 and create-record of a movement child.

fundamentals.capability: A transaction of two or more account legs that is one committed fact: its legs net to zero in one unit, it has its own id, number, actor, memo and references, and a read returns the whole transaction.
fundamentals.why: Strata posts one journal entry per account (ledger-posting-request has one owner, unit and amount; ledger-entry has no transaction header). Operations can post several entries atomically (opr-1541), but nothing checks that the legs of one operation net to zero or groups them for a read. Checked: specifications/boundary.jsonc ledger-* types, tenant-operation-step post-ledger, kernel crates/kernel/src/ledger.rs post_after.

fundamentals.capability: Credit that expires on its own date per grant, consumed earliest-expiry first, carried with the same expiry through transfers and restored with it on refund or reversal.
fundamentals.why: Strata expiry is per unit and per calendar period: ledger-unit-decl carries one ledger-expiry {period, periods}, buckets hold credit per period start, and a debit consumes the oldest bucket (ldg-1545). Per-award expiry, exact timestamps, lot rows and restore with the original expiry are not in the spec. Checked: boundary ledger-expiry, ledger-bucket, ledger-unit-decl; requirements ldg-1545, ldg-1546, ldg-2883, ldg-2900.

fundamentals.capability: Rules, segment predicates, computed fields and triggers can read a ledger balance, a lifetime total and a tier derived from them.
fundamentals.why: The expression grammar (boundary expr) has no balance, lifetime or tier variant, and ledger-posted triggers bind owner and amount only. The showcase reports this as gap 3; D-6545 decided segment balances on 2026-11-20 but they have not landed. Checked: boundary expr, trigger-event; strata-showcase tests/corpus/showcase/README.md gap 3.

fundamentals.capability: Queries and aggregates over ledger entries and accounts, filtered by unit, owner, date, reason and amount, with totals, visibility filtering and scan bounds.
fundamentals.why: query-def reads an object type only; the ledger is read by list-ledger-entries (per account, no date or reason filter, no totals) and list-ledger-accounts (ranked by balance, 100 per page, scan bound 10,000). Checked: boundary query-def, list-ledger-entries, list-ledger-accounts; requirements ldg-1543, ldg-2890, ldg-2891.

fundamentals.capability: A tenant-wide check that recomputes conservation across units and pools, compares every balance with its replayed entries and its lots, and returns a stored report of drift and gaps.
fundamentals.why: verify-ledger-balance (CT-287) and ldg-020 work per account. No whole-ledger sum, per-unit conservation or report exists. Checked: boundary verify-ledger-balance, requirements ldg-020, ldg-2886.

fundamentals.capability: An operation invocation, by an agent or above a declared threshold, is held as a pending proposal with its exact input; a different authorised person approves it, and the held input is then committed once.
fundamentals.why: request-approval exists only as an automation step (automation-approval, WFL-2680 to 2683). Tenant operations take invokers (signed-in, roles) and have no hold, and there is no agent ceiling for operations. Checked: boundary tenant-operation-invokers, tenant-operation-step, automation-step request-approval.

fundamentals.capability: Policies that refuse one principal acting on itself, or holding two roles that must not be combined, checked at commit for every operation.
fundamentals.why: A condition can compare principal with a record field (expr principal), so self-action is expressible per operation, but it is not a platform rule and role-assignment has no exclusion between roles. Checked: boundary expr principal, role-assignment, tenant-role; requirements wfl-2681 (automation starter may not approve).

fundamentals.capability: A role granted with a scope attribute (region, team or similar) that is ANDed into policies and row filters over records, and a principal attribute readable in conditions.
fundamentals.why: role-assignment names a principal or a team but no scope; expr can read the principal only as a subject and has-role, not the principal's region or department. Checked: boundary role-assignment, expr; strata-showcase README gap 2 (tenant-wide roles).

fundamentals.capability: Realtime and notice events that name an audience (a principal, a role, or everyone) and whose payload is filtered by each subscriber's read rights.
fundamentals.why: Live bindings and notices exist, and ldg-2887 filters ledger notices by read decision, but events are not declared with a role audience and there is no per-event audience in trigger-event. Checked: requirements ldg-2887, ldg-2895; boundary trigger-event.

fundamentals.capability: Pure evaluation of ranked, stackable, budgeted rules over a basket or an earn event, returning applied and rejected rules with reasons, totals, and a fingerprint of the result that a commit can check.
fundamentals.why: No rule-evaluation construct: expr evaluates one expression, and operations have fixed steps. Plinth's evaluation (priority, exclusive and stack groups, caps, budget drop-and-retry, deterministic order) is in CONTRACT §8.3. Checked: boundary expr and tenant-operation-step.

fundamentals.capability: An operation step repeated for each item of a list input (or of rows found), with per-item idempotency keys and a declared outcome per item.
fundamentals.why: tenant-operation-step is a fixed list with no loop and no lookups over lists (showcase gap 8). Automation fan-out exists over segment members only. Checked: boundary tenant-operation-step, automation-step fan-out.

fundamentals.capability: Counts, streaks and rates over an entity's event history within a sliding or calendar time window, readable by rules and aggregates.
fundamentals.why: An expression reads one record and one reference, with no aggregate and no history; the showcase reports streaks and time windows as not expressible (gap 11). Checked: boundary expr, aggregate-def; showcase README gap 11.

fundamentals.capability: Gapless human-readable numbers per workspace and kind (R-000123, txn_no, task_no), allocated in the same transaction as the record.
fundamentals.why: Strata ids are derived or random (ledger-account-id derived, record ids); no sequence declaration exists. Checked: boundary ledger-account-id, record id types.

fundamentals.capability: Records that no operation or policy can update or delete after creation, declared on the object.
fundamentals.why: Immutability is by policy grant only (policy-def actions, tenant-permission object-action); no append-only flag on objects. Checked: boundary policy-def, tenant-permission, object definitions.

fundamentals.capability: Every committed change records actor, on-behalf-of principal, surface, approval and idempotency key, and the record of those is verifiable as a chain.
fundamentals.why: ledger-entry records caused-by and idempotency-key only; on_behalf_of, surface and approval link are absent. The journal exists (journal-entry, replay-journal) but its hashing is not described in the boundary types. Checked: boundary ledger-entry, journal-entry, journal-replay.

fundamentals.capability: A field derived at read time from other fields, aggregates, the balance or the viewer (for example stock status, allowed transitions, progress ratio).
fundamentals.why: No computed field in field-type or view-section; views draw stored fields and aggregates. Checked: boundary field-type, view-section.

fundamentals.capability: Listing with facet counts per attribute, text search across fields, sort and per-viewer state (wishlist, cart) joined into each row.
fundamentals.why: query-def has filter, order, limit and aggregates but facets are one group-by per aggregate and per-viewer joins are not in the query type. Checked: boundary query-def, aggregate-def.

fundamentals.capability: A count or quantity limit per owner per object (for example per member per product), whose value comes from that object and not from a unit or a declared account.
fundamentals.why: Ledger limits apply per unit or per declared account, at most 10,000 per tenant (ldg-1550). Per-product limit values would each need an account limit. Checked: requirements ldg-1542, ldg-1550, ldg-2882.

fundamentals.capability: A timed event at a time read from a field of each record (promotion start and end, expiry day), not only at a declared recurrence.
fundamentals.why: schedule-due fires on a schedule declared once (schedule-summary rule and next-due); per-record times need the scheduler to read records. Checked: boundary schedule-summary, trigger-event schedule-due.

fundamentals.capability: A uniqueness constraint over the rows that match a condition (only live awards, one open entitlement per member and promotion).
fundamentals.why: field-type unique is unconditional; there is no partial unique constraint. Checked: boundary field-type, object unique declarations.
